name: GhostField
description: Compound field primitive connecting GhostFieldLabel, GhostFieldDescription, GhostFieldError, and GhostFieldControl to a single control via useGhostId and scoped slot props. Composes with GhostInput, GhostTextarea, and GhostCheckbox without API changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Propagates disabled semantics to the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Optional control id override for label association.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Propagates invalid semantics and root data-state.

props.name: required
props.description: Propagates required semantics to the control.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Field parts (label, description, control, error) in consumer-chosen order.

parts.name: error
parts.description: Rendered by GhostFieldError when the slot has content.

parts.name: control
parts.description: Scoped slot bridge from GhostFieldControl (no DOM host).

states.name: invalid
states.description: Root invalid state; wins over disabled.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Root disabled state when not invalid.
